title-info.book-title: Cool Reader 3 for PocketBook: User Manual

annotation.p: User manual of Cool Reader 3 for PocketBook, OPDS edition (0.0.6-17-67-opds).
It is an English edition of the Russian manual by biv_sumy and kaznelson, brought up to date with the current menus and the features of this build.

history.p: 1.0 – English edition for the build CoolReader OPDS 0.0.6-17-67, made from the Russian manual 1.7 [pozhydaiev7, 11.2026].

section.p: The program reads files of the following formats:
FB2, FB3, EPUB, HTML, CHM, TXT, RTF, DOC, DOCX, ODT

It has a table of contents, bookmarks, search, a list of the recently opened books, dictionaries and cites, a jump to any page, information about the open file and the program version, adjustable text styles and interface skins.
The program controls the front light and works with covers that put the device to sleep.

This build (CoolReader OPDS) also has: online OPDS book catalogs with search and download, StarDict and XDXF dictionaries, a word lookup in several dictionaries at once, reading statistics, automatic page rotation by the position sensor, and it runs on firmware 6.11.

cite.p: The settings described in this manual may differ from the current settings on your device.
The English edition has no screenshots. The Russian and Ukrainian manuals (cr3-manual-ru.fb2, cr3-manual-uk.fb2 in system/share/cr3/manual) have them.

section.p: The main control of the device is the touch screen. A touch of the screen is called a tap.
There are two kinds of taps:
• short – touch the screen and let go;
• long – touch and hold for more than a second.
A tap without a stated kind is always a short one; a long tap is always named.
The screen is divided into 9 areas with adjustable height and width, the tap zones. Each tap zone can have two actions: one for a short and one for a long tap.
The program also understands gestures (swipes):
• line – move a finger across the screen;
• pinch – move two fingers together or apart.
A vertical swipe changes the front light, a horizontal swipe turns the page, a pinch changes the font size.
Full-screen service windows have a status line at the bottom. A tap to the left or right of the page number turns the pages of the list; the arrow on the left closes the window.
A window that does not take the whole screen is usually closed by a tap outside of it.
On a touch device the keys are a secondary control, so this manual covers only what reading needs.

cite.p: The key assignments of PocketBook come before those of Cool Reader. To use your own actions, clear the keys in the PocketBook settings first.

section.p: The keys: Home, Prev (back), Next (forward), Menu, Power.
The main key actions are set in the settings of the device:
Settings > Personalize > Key mapping
There are two kinds of key presses:
• short – press and release;
• long – press and hold for more than a second.
Keys cannot be reassigned in the Cool Reader settings: the file keymaps.ini is edited by hand (see «Key assignments»).
This manual assumes the following key actions:

cite.p: • In a book Menu opens the reading menu, a long press opens the main menu. Next/Prev turn pages.
• In service windows Menu confirms, a long press cancels the choice or closes the window. Next/Prev turn pages; Prev usually also closes the first or the only window.
• Home keeps the default PocketBook action.

section.p: The status line (page header) is at the top of the screen; the settings let you compose it or turn it off.
The status line can show, from left to right:

cite.p: • author / book title (in turn);
• current time;
• page / pages to the end of the chapter / total;
• how much is read, in percent;
• battery charge.

section.p: Under them is the progress line; vertical marks on it show the chapters.
The text of the book is below the status line. It may have links and footnotes. Footnotes are shown in one of two ways, chosen in the settings:

cite.p: • as links to the notes at the end of the book;
• in full at the bottom of the page (the part that does not fit goes to the next page).

section.p: A long tap on a link, a footnote or a comment opens their pop-up menu. The Prev key closes it.
The item «Go to link» or the Next key turns on the link mode. A navigation panel appears with the actions Back, Forward, Position, Cancel; its look depends on the interface skin.
The left arrow returns to the place of reading; the up arrow moves the panel to the opposite edge of the screen; the X on the right turns the link mode off.
The Menu key, or a tap in the centre of the page, gives quick access to the main features of the program.
Items of the reading menu, from left to right:

cite.p: • Exit the book – to the screen it was opened from;
• Contents – open the table of contents;
• Bookmarks – open the list of bookmarks;
• Dictionary – open the chosen dictionary;
• Search – look for a word or a phrase in the book;
• Book catalog – open an online catalog (OPDS);
• Reading statistics – open the reports of the reading time;
• Rotate – turn the screen in steps of 90°;
• Settings – open the settings menu.

section.p: To go to any page, move the slider in the lower part of the reading menu, or tap the page numbers above the slider and type the number.
The front light is set in the system panel, opened by the button / . There it can be turned on or off and its brightness changed with a slider.
A vertical swipe along the right side of the screen also changes the front light.
section.subtitle: Classic reading menu
section.p: If the interface skin is not one of pb617fw5, pb618fw5, pb626fw5, pb631fw5, pb700fw5, pb740fw5 or pbXfw5, the reading menu has the classic look of the old PocketBook devices: a block of 9 icons in the centre of the screen.
Its items (left to right, top to bottom):

cite.p: • Go to page;
• Exit the book;
• Search for a word or a phrase;
• List of bookmarks;
• Close this menu;
• Rotate the screen;
• Dictionary;
• Contents;
• Settings.

section.p: The commands of this menu can be changed in keymaps.ini; the look of the icons depends on the interface skin.
This item of the reading menu shows the table of contents and goes to a chapter of the open book. The page numbers of the chapters are turned on in the display settings («Page numbers in TOC»).
The current chapter has an angle mark. To go to another chapter, tap its row.
section.subtitle: Classic contents
section.p: If «Use new TOC menu» is turned off in the display settings, the contents are a plain list of chapters with indents and page numbers. The list works with every interface skin and on every firmware.

cite.p: The contents window of the PocketBook theme used before closed the program on firmware 6.11, so this build replaces it.

section.p: A short tap on this item of the reading menu opens the list of the bookmarks of the book; a long tap sets a bookmark on the current page.
In the list you can make new bookmarks and go to the pages of the old ones. The chosen bookmark has a triangle mark.
A long tap on a row opens the context menu: set a bookmark, delete it or go to its page.
Keys in the list of bookmarks:
Next/Prev – turn pages;
Next/Prev (long) – choose what a tap on a row does (go / set).

cite.p: About 60 bookmarks can be made; after that an error message is shown.

section.p: The dictionary window opens in the lower part of the screen.
One word of the text is already underlined; the window shows its translation or a list of the nearest dictionary words. To choose another word, tap it.
The window has a caption with the name of the dictionary and a panel of six buttons, from left to right:

cite.p: • Close the dictionary window;
• Search in Google (needs a network);
• Search in Wiki (needs a network);
• List of dictionary words;
• Back to the book to choose a word;
• Type a word and look it up.

section.p: To change the dictionary, tap the caption of the window and choose a dictionary in the list.
The arrow in the caption closes the dictionary window.
section.subtitle: Which dictionaries work
section.p: One list shows dictionaries of three kinds:
• PocketBook dictionaries (*.dic);
• StarDict dictionaries: the files .ifo, .idx (or .idx.gz), .dict (or .dict.dz) and, if there is one, .syn with word forms («houses» finds «house»);
• XDXF dictionaries: a plain .xdxf file, not compressed.

StarDict and XDXF dictionaries have their format after the name. All dictionaries go to the folder system/dictionaries of the internal memory or of the card: each dictionary in a folder of its own, or straight into that folder.

cite.p: The built-in dictionaries of firmware 6.11 are kept in a closed part of the memory, and the program cannot read them.

section.subtitle: Selected dictionaries
section.p: The first row of the dictionary list is «Selected dictionaries»: the word is looked up in several dictionaries at once (up to five). They are checked under «Check dictionaries...»: a tap on a row sets or clears the mark [x].
The articles of different dictionaries are separated by a line, each with the name of its dictionary in small type. With no dictionary checked nothing is looked up, and the dictionary window says so.
section.subtitle: Paging the article and the book
section.p: A long article and the list of words are paged by a vertical swipe over the dictionary window; the caption shows the page number of the article. Turning the pages of the book with the keys or a horizontal swipe does not close the dictionary window.
section.subtitle: Search keyboard
section.p: A word is typed on the keyboard of the program: English, Russian and Ukrainian layouts, the keys are placed as on the firmware keyboard; with the inverse display (night mode) it is dark. The firmware keyboard can be chosen instead (see «Settings» > «Dictionary settings»). Devices without a touch screen always use the firmware keyboard.
To look for a word or a phrase in the book, type it on the on-screen keyboard of the firmware. Next starts the search, Prev closes the keyboard.

This item of the reading menu opens an online library: browse its sections, search it, download a book and open it at once, without leaving the program. Wi-Fi is needed; if it is off, the program asks the device to connect.
The icon opens the default catalog, or the list of catalogs when none is the default. The same list is in the settings menu: «OPDS catalogs».
section.subtitle: List of catalogs
section.p: Flibusta is always in the list: its address can be changed to a mirror, but it cannot be deleted or renamed. Other catalogs are added with «Add catalog...» (address and name).
«Edit catalogs...» changes the name and the address of a catalog, makes it the default catalog or deletes it.
section.subtitle: Navigation
section.p: The arrow in the caption and the first row of every screen go one level up; from the start page of the catalog, back to the book.

In a list of books each book takes two lines: the title and the author. A long list is turned with the arrows in the top right corner, the screen number is between them. The row «Catalog menu» opens the menu: back to the list, search, catalog start page, other catalog, catalog address.
section.subtitle: Search
section.p: The search takes two steps, as the catalog serves it: first choose what to look for (authors or books), then the list of results opens.
section.subtitle: Book screen
section.p: The book screen shows the title and the author (a tap opens the full description: genres, year, format, language, size, series, annotation), the rows «Download and open» for every format the catalog offers, and links to other books of the author and of the series.

A downloaded book is saved to the folder Books/Flibusta, opens at once, and appears in the PocketBook library and in the list of recent books on the home screen. The position in the previous book is saved first.
The program records how long every page stays on the screen and builds reports from that. Open them with the chart icon of the reading menu or with «Reading statistics» in the settings menu.
section.subtitle: What counts as reading
section.p: • a page shown for less than 5 seconds was only turned over and is not counted;
• more than 2 minutes on one page counts as 2 minutes;
• standby and leaving the book stop the clock.
section.subtitle: Reports
section.p: • the report of the current book: when it was started and finished, reading days, pages read of the total, total time, time left to the end, average time per page and per reading day, time by days;
• the reports of a period (today, this week from Monday, this month, this year, all time, or your own dates as dd.mm.yyyy-dd.mm.yyyy): pages and words, books, total time, time by days and by books;
• the list of all books with their total reading time; a tap opens the report of the book.
The log is the file system/state/cr3/cr3stats.txt; an update of the program keeps it. Delete the file to start the statistics over.
This item of the reading menu turns the screen to one of four angles: 0°; 90°; 180°; 270°. Tap an icon: the panel closes and the screen turns.

On devices with a position sensor the page can turn by itself: with 360° in «Control settings» > «Rotate» it turns by 90° when the reader lies on its side. Only CoolReader is rotated; the orientation of the system stays.
This item of the reading menu changes the parameters of the program, so that the text of a book looks the way you like.

cite.p: A change of some parameters makes the program count the pages of the open book again.

section.p: A list, several pages long, of all fonts on the device, system and user ones. The current font has a triangle mark. Each font is shown as it looks in a book.
Value: list of fonts
A list of the sizes of the reading font, each shown in its own size. The current size has a triangle mark.
Value: 16 to 300
A submenu with the fine settings of the font.
section.subtitle: Font weight
section.p: The stroke thickness of the main font. «Normal» is the weight 400, «Bold» is 700; the values between them make the text a little denser or lighter. It works with any font: when the family has no file of the weight, the program thickens the letters itself.

cite.p: This item replaces the former «Normal / Bold» and «Font embolding»; the saved values are converted at the first start.

section.subtitle: Font antialiasing
section.p: Smooths the jagged edges of the characters.
Value: on for all fonts / on for big fonts only / off
section.subtitle: Font hinting
section.p: Adjusts the outline of a glyph to the pixel grid, for sharper small fonts and low-resolution screens.
Value: no hinting / use bytecode / autohinting
section.subtitle: Font kerning
section.p: Changes the space between certain pairs of letters by their shape, for a more even look of the text.
Value: on / off
section.subtitle: Tracking
section.p: An even change (unlike kerning) of the space between all letters, in 1/1000 of the font height. Negative values bring the letters closer.
Value: -50 to 250
section.subtitle: Font Gamma
section.p: A factor for the drawing of the characters: the higher it is, the more contrast and the fewer halftones. With a very high value the letters get rough edges and the antialiasing is lost.
Value: 0.3 to 11.0 (1 by default)
section.subtitle: Document embedded fonts
section.p: Use the fonts that come inside the document.
Value: on / off
section.subtitle: Fallback font face
section.p: The font for the characters that the reading font does not have.
Value: list of fonts
A submenu with the fine settings of the text on a page.
section.subtitle: Interline space
section.p: The space between the lines of the text.
Value: 70% to 200%
section.subtitle: Hyphenation
section.p: A hyphenation table, the algorithmic mode, or no hyphenation.
The tables (from AlReader) are in the folder system/share/cr3/hyph of the internal memory; other patterns can be added there.
Value: list of hyphenation tables
section.subtitle: Preformatted text
section.p: Text files formatted with spaces, tabs and line breaks.
Value: on / off
section.subtitle: Space condensing percent
section.p: The smallest width a space may be squeezed to when a line is justified.
Value: 25% to 100%
section.subtitle: Letter spacing in justified lines
section.p: How much the program may add between the letters of a justified line, so as not to stretch the spaces too far. With 0% the letters are not spread.
Value: 0% to 20%
section.subtitle: Floating punctuation
section.p: With it on, only the letters are aligned to the right edge of the text, and the punctuation marks hang over that edge; otherwise all characters are aligned alike.
Value: on / off
section.subtitle: Image scaling
section.p: The scaling mode and the largest scale of the pictures of a book.
Value: integer scale / arbitrary scale / disabled (1:1)
Value: auto / *1 / *2 / *3
Value: integer scale / arbitrary scale / disabled (1:1)
Value: auto / *1 / *2 / *3
A submenu with the look of a book page.
section.subtitle: Status line
section.p: Show the status line with various information at the top of the reading screen.
Value: on / off
section.subtitle: Status line settings
section.p: What the status line shows and how it looks.
Font face – list of fonts
Font size – 16 to 300
Font weight – normal / bold
Time format – 24h / AM/PM
Show time – on / off
Show title – the author and the title of the book; when they do not fit together, they are shown in turn; on / off
Show battery – on / off
Show battery percent – the exact charge instead of the segment indicator; on / off
Show position percent – on / off
Show page count – on / off
Show page count till chapter end – on / off
Show page number – on / off
Show chapter marks – the chapter marks on the progress line; on / off
section.subtitle: Page margins
section.p: The distance from the text to the edges of the screen: top, bottom, left and right.
Value: 0 to 350
section.subtitle: Footnotes at page bottom
section.p: Show the notes at the bottom of the page, under the text of the book.
Value: on / off
A submenu with the visual settings of the pages.
section.subtitle: Page orientation
section.p: The orientation of the screen while reading.
Value: 0° (portrait) / 90° / 180° / 270°
section.subtitle: Landscape pages
section.p: The number of text columns in the landscape orientation.
Value: one / two
section.subtitle: Inverse display
section.p: The colors of the page and of the text: black on white, or white on black (night mode).
Value: normal / inverse
section.subtitle: Highlight bookmarks
section.p: How the saved cites are marked in the text of the book.
Value: solid / underline / none
section.subtitle: Display update mode
section.p: How often the screen is fully refreshed while reading.
Value: never / always / every 2 to 50 pages
section.subtitle: Standby
section.p: The time without actions after which the program enters the power saving mode.
Value: off / 1 minute to 2 hours
section.subtitle: Gray buffer depth (needs restart)
section.p: The number of gray shades of the page buffer.
Value: auto / 2 / 3 / 4 / 8 bits per pixel
section.subtitle: Custom system theme (needs restart)
section.p: A system theme that changes the look of PocketBook.
Value: on / off

cite.p: A theme that does not suit your device may break the interface.

section.subtitle: Use new TOC menu
section.p: Show the table of contents in the new style; otherwise show a plain list of chapters with indents and page numbers.
Value: on / off
section.subtitle: Page numbers in TOC
section.p: Show the page numbers of the chapters in the new table of contents.
Value: on / off
section.subtitle: Skin
section.p: One of the interface skins, which change the look of the program.
Value: list of skin files

cite.p: Skins of other authors can be installed, with no promise that they fit.
The new reading menu works only with the skins pb617fw5 / pb618fw5 / pb626fw5 / pb631fw5 / pb700fw5 / pb740fw5 / pbXfw5.
When no skin is chosen, the program takes one by the size of the screen.

section.p: A submenu with the settings of the dictionary window.
section.subtitle: Dictionary window
section.p: Where the dictionary window is shown: away from the chosen word (the window moves to the opposite edge of the screen by itself), always at the top or always at the bottom.
Value: away from the word / at the top / at the bottom
section.subtitle: Word search
section.p: What is shown when the dictionary does not have the word: the list of the nearest words, or a message that the word is not found.
Value: with nearest words / exact
section.subtitle: Search keyboard
section.p: The keyboard for typing a word. Only devices with a touch screen have this item.
Value: CoolReader, with night mode / firmware
The touch controls that work while reading.
section.subtitle: Rotate
section.p: What the program does when the device is turned. With 360° (the default) the page turns by 90° when the reader lies on its side, for example when you read lying down; with 180° it only turns upside down. With the «180+» values a tilt of the device also turns the pages of the book.
Value: 360° / 180° / 180° with page turning by tilt (five variants)

cite.p: Only devices with a position sensor have this item. Only CoolReader is rotated; the orientation of the system stays.

section.subtitle: Page turn angle
section.p: The tilt of the device at which a page is turned, for the «180+» values.
Value: list of angles
section.subtitle: Tap action / Long tap action
section.p: The actions of the tap zones of the touch screen. The current actions are shown on a picture of the zones; a tap on a zone opens the list of actions, the current one has a triangle mark.
Value: list of actions
section.subtitle: Height of the upper / middle tap zone
section.p: The sizes of the horizontal bands (3 zones).
Value: 20% to 60%
section.subtitle: Width of the left / middle tap zone
section.p: The sizes of the vertical bands (3 zones).
Value: 20% to 60%
section.subtitle: Page Turn Swipes
section.p: Turn the pages with a horizontal swipe.
Value: on / off
section.subtitle: Front Light Swipes
section.p: Change the front light with a vertical swipe.
Value: off / fixed / dynamic
section.subtitle: Pinch zoom
section.p: Change the font size with a pinch: fingers together make the letters smaller, fingers apart make them bigger.
Value: on / off

cite.p: This way of zooming does not work on firmware 6.

section.p: The look of separate elements of a book, over the common styles.
section.subtitle: Document embedded styles
section.p: Use the style sheets that come inside the document.
Value: on / off
section.subtitle: Elements
section.p: Default paragraph formatting, Title, Subtitle, Preformatted text / code, Link, Cite, Epigraph, Poem, Text / Cite / Epigraph author, Footnote, Footnote link, Footnote title, Annotation.
section.subtitle: Parameters of each element
section.p: Text alignment – justify / left / center / right
First line indent – no indent / small or big indent / small or big outdent
Font face – list of fonts
Font size – smaller, 95% to 60% / bigger, 105% to 150%
Font weight – normal / bold / bolder / lighter
Font style – normal / italic
Interline space – 75% to 150%
Letter spacing – 0px to 5px
Text decoration – none / underline / line through / overline
Text vertical alignment – baseline / subscript / superscript
Text color / Background color – black / gray / white
Margin before / after – 0 to 2 line heights
Margin left / right – 0 to 4 line heights / 5% to 30% of the line width
Clears the cache of the documents, the cache of the open book included.
Opens the list of the online book catalogs: open a catalog, add one, change a name and an address, set the default catalog (see «Book catalog (OPDS)»).
Opens the reports of the reading time (see «Reading statistics»).
This menu has the features that are not in the reading menu. To open it, make a long tap on the centre tap zone of the reading screen.

cite.p: The items of the main menu can be changed, so the description below is true for the package this manual comes with.

section.p: Opens a book read before without leaving the program. The chosen book has a triangle mark.
A long tap on a row opens the context menu: open the book or delete its record.

cite.p: Deleting a record also deletes the bookmarks and the cites of that book.

section.p: Turns on the link mode described above. A navigation panel appears with the actions Back, Forward, Position, Cancel.

The left and right arrows move through the links used in this reading session. The up or down arrow moves the panel to the opposite edge of the screen when it covers a link. The X on the right turns the link mode off; the book stays at the place of the last jump.
Opens the list of all cites of the open book. Cites are saved as text files in the memory of the device (the folder cr3_notes). The chosen cite has a triangle mark.
A long tap on a row opens the context menu: delete the cite or go to its page.

cite.p: Only one cite can be made from this list. For more, use the item «Cite selection dialog» of the main menu.

section.p: Makes a new cite. The cite panel is shown on the page of the book; the middle paragraph is chosen to start with.
The cites saved before are underlined or filled with gray (see «Highlight bookmarks» in the display settings).
The panel at the bottom of the screen builds the block of the cite:
/ – confirm / cancel the choice;
the paragraph buttons – choose the first paragraph of the block, add a paragraph to the block, remove a paragraph from it;
the sentence buttons – add a sentence to the block, remove a sentence from it;
the up and down buttons – move the block.
Keys:
Prev – move the start of the block up;
Next – move the end of the block down;
Menu – confirm; Menu (long) – cancel.
The cite panel closes only when the choice is confirmed or cancelled.
Shows information about the open book, the version of the program and other service data.
Keys: Next/Prev – turn pages; Next/Prev (long) – font size; Menu – close.
Shows the actions assigned to the hardware keys of the device for reading.
Opens this manual. The program opens the manual in the language of the device; when there is none in that language, the English one.
Keys: Next/Prev – turn pages; Next/Prev (long) – font size; Menu – close the manual.

Opens the system panel of the device at the top of the screen. There you can change the brightness of the front light or turn it on and off; some settings and applications of PocketBook are there too.
Closes the open book and goes to the place of the device the book was opened from: the home screen or the library.

The actions of the keys are assigned in the file keymaps.ini in the folder system/share/cr3/keymaps of the internal memory. The file of definitions next to it (keydefs.ini) lists all possible actions.
Short and long presses are supported; some commands repeat while the key is held.
section.subtitle: Key codes
section.p: Home – KEY_HOME; Menu – KEY_MENU; the page keys – KEY_NEXT, KEY_PREV
section.subtitle: Assigning an action
section.p: A short press, no parameters:
A long press, a command repeated while the key is held, 10 pages at a time:
section.subtitle: Sections of the file
section.p: [main] – the main window, where books are read;
[menu] – the main menu and the settings;
[bookmarks] – the lists of bookmarks, cites and recent books;
[cite] – the cite panel;
[dict] – the dictionary panel;
[dialog] – dialog windows (About);
[browse] – the manual and the list of key actions;
[quickMenuItems] – the commands of the classic reading menu (9 commands, by item number);
[mainMenuItems] – the commands of the main menu (any number, by item number).
section.subtitle: Some commands
section.p: DCMD_PAGEDOWN, DCMD_PAGEUP – next and previous page;
DCMD_BEGIN, DCMD_END – start and end of the book;
DCMD_MOVE_BY_CHAPTER – go by chapters;
DCMD_ZOOM_IN, DCMD_ZOOM_OUT – bigger and smaller font;
PB_QUICK_MENU – reading menu; MCMD_MAIN_MENU – main menu;
MCMD_SETTINGS – settings; MCMD_DICT – dictionary; MCMD_SEARCH – search;
MCMD_BOOKMARK_LIST – bookmarks; MCMD_CITES_LIST, MCMD_CITE – cites;
MCMD_RECENT_BOOK_LIST – recent books; MCMD_GO_PAGE – go to page;
PB_CMD_CONTENTS – contents; PB_CMD_ROTATE – rotate;
PB_CMD_FRONT_LIGHT, PB_CMD_FRONT_LIGHT_TOGGLE – front light;
PB_CMD_SET_BOOKMARK, PB_CMD_UNSET_BOOKMARK – set and delete a bookmark;
PB_CMD_FULL_UPDATE – refresh the screen; PB_CMD_INVERT_DISPLAY – inverse display;
PB_CMD_OPEN_SYSTEM_PANEL – system panel; PB_CMD_CLEAR_CACHE – clear cache;
MCMD_ABOUT – about the book; MCMD_HELP – this manual; MCMD_QUIT – close the book.

The smallest size of a book, in bytes, for saving it in the cache:

Search keyboard of the dictionary (0 – CoolReader / 1 – firmware):
OPDS catalogs (N is the number, 0 is Flibusta), the default catalog (its number plus one; 0 – none) and the folder for the downloaded books:

Battery in the status line (1 – percent / 0 – icon) and whether it is shown:
